content: To show the effects of using the hybrid training data, we trained two models of the same architecture and hyperparameters. One model was trained on the hybrid data and will be referred to as hybrid NER model. The other model was trained on clinical notes only and will be referred to as i2b2 NER model. We evaluated the performance of the NER models by micro-F1 score on the test set of both the synthesized queries and the i2b2 data.
